scope: New open-source software and FPGA emulator implementations for computers, consoles, handhelds, synthesizers and arcade systems; no ROM or firmware payloads copied.

projects.title: Tiny386
projects.game: IBM PC-compatible x86 software and operating systems
projects.platform: x86 PC system emulation on desktop hosts and ESP32-S3-class MCUs; the README lists 386 with selected 486/586 and amd64 features
projects.status: The rolling `continuous` release was published 2026-10-08 and the source was pushed that day. The README reports Windows 9x/NT booting on MCUs such as ESP32-S3, and lists missing debugging, hardware-tasking, and permission-check features.
projects.summary: Portable C99 full-system x86 PC emulator with an i386 CPU model, optional x87 FPU, and modeled PC peripherals. The maintainer reports Windows 9x/NT booting on ESP32-S3; the BIOS and VGA BIOS are external SeaBIOS-derived files configured by the user.
projects.strategy: C99 software emulator for x86 CPU and PC peripheral hardware, with selected peripherals ported from TinyEMU and QEMU.
projects.source_available: Public BSD-3-Clause source repository. The README says BIOS/VGA BIOS files come from SeaBIOS and must be supplied by path; the BSD-3-Clause project license does not determine rights for those firmware files or user disk images. Optional OPL audio code has separate upstream provenance.

projects.title: nd100x
projects.game: Norsk Data ND-100/CX software, including SINTRAN III
projects.platform: ND-100/CX minicomputer emulation; native Linux, Windows, macOS and RISC-V builds plus a WebAssembly browser build
projects.status: GitHub lists v1.0.22 as the latest release (2026-10-11); the RetroCoreLabs repository was pushed 2026-10-15. The README status section still says v1.0.16 and reports SINTRAN L booting from SMD plus optional ND-500-family support, so those version references do not match.
projects.summary: C emulator for the Norsk Data ND-100/CX, modeling its CPU, memory management, disk controllers, terminals, networking and other devices. The maintainer describes nd100x as a substantially extended fork of nd100em and documents SINTRAN operation; the repository also bundles disk and software images.
projects.strategy: Full-system C emulator derived from nd100em, with native and WebAssembly frontends.
projects.source_available: Public GPL-3.0 (GitHub/LICENSE); README describes GPL v2 or later source repository. The GitHub-detected LICENSE file is GPL-3.0 text, while README prose describes inherited GPL v2-or-later terms; resolve that documentation discrepancy before relying on a precise version claim. The repository bundles Norsk Data disk/software images, including SINTRAN material; image rights and redistribution terms are separate from the emulator code.

projects.title: NESER
projects.game: NES/Famicom, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance and SNES software
projects.status: The maintainer published v1.3.0 on 2026-10-01 and pushed the repository on 2026-10-08. The README documents the five Nintendo system families and native/browser frontends, with per-system support notes in separate README files.
projects.summary: Rust multi-system emulator with shared audio, video, input, save-state, configuration, ROM browsing and debugging paths for Nintendo NES/Famicom, Game Boy/Color, Game Boy Advance and SNES software. Commercial game images are not covered by the MIT code license.
projects.strategy: Shared Rust emulation engine and native/browser frontends for multiple Nintendo systems.
projects.source_available: Public MIT source repository. MIT-licensed source; users supply game ROMs. The SNES README says DSP-1/2/3/4 games require genuine firmware files supplied by the user; those firmware and game-image rights remain separate.
projects.subtype: Software multi-system console and handheld emulator
